notes: Primary source is Newline's official "RS+ Series Full Specifications" PDF (newline-interactive.com), which explicitly tables the TT-7519RS alongside TT-6519RS and TT-8619RS and lists: Input Ports "(2) HDMI 2.0 4K@60Hz; (1) DisplayPort 1.2 4K@60Hz; (1) VGA; (1) PC Audio In; (1) Microphone in; (5) USB Touch; (2) USB 2.0"; Output Ports "(1) HDMI out - Supports 4k@60Hz, 1920x1080@60Hz"; Other Ports "(1) USB 2.0; (1) USB 3.0; (1) Embedded USB 2.0; (1) RS232; (2) RJ45; (1) DC 5V-2A out; (1) Line Out; (1) SPDIF out". Working voltage AC 100-240V 50/60Hz, max power ≤400W. Cross-checked port layout/labels (HDMI1/HDMI2/HDMI FRONT, DP, VGA, USB Touch, RS232, LAN x2, DC out, Line/Audio out, SPDIF) against the front/rear port diagrams in Newline's predecessor "RS-series" user manual (which covers the closely related TT-6518RS/TT-7518RS/TT-8618RS/TT-9818RS naming generation) for physical confirmation; port counts and generation-specific HDMI/DP versions were taken from the RS+ spec PDF since it is the sheet that names TT-7519RS directly. The AC input connector type (IEC C14) is inferred from the rear-panel diagram (a standard IEC inlet with adjacent rocker switch) rather than an explicit "IEC" label in the text spec sheet — flagged as a minor inference. The "USB Touch" ports are the panel's built-in touch-controller USB connections (paired with each video input for HID touch data), not general-purpose USB-A file ports; modeled as usb-a/bidirectional since that is the closest connector type. No grade is set on the RJ45 (Ethernet) ports because the source materials do not state a link speed (likely Fast/Gigabit Ethernet for OS/network features, but unconfirmed). No grade is set on USB 3.0 beyond usb-5g since the spec sheet says "USB 3.0" without further qualifier (assumed base USB 3.0 = 5Gbps, i.e. usb-5g). This is a desktop/wall-mounted interactive flat panel display, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted conceptually; set to 0/not applicable).
